meta.title: For Ruhi
meta.from: A friend who has known you a long time

node.note: optional smaller line under the body

start.body:
Ruhi… it has been more than 1.5 year, we know each other.

Aur itne time mein I have asked you many times to meet you, and you only agreed once! And I have always respected your will (Just as I will time time too). I am not going to ask for very big gesture or having any expectations.

Just a simple genune request..
start.note: Jo bhi jawab ho, woh theek hai.

message3.body:
Ruhi, no-one knows the future, kal ye time, ye chance ho na ho.. Aakhir zindagi ka kya bharosa. Aur kismat toh kabhi nahi chahati ki hamari baat bhi ho, isslye I rely on efforts than luck.. 

 and I am ready to put this much efforts just to spend some time with you, it shows how much you are important to me. 

In past you have given 1 year of Relationship to someone who I'm sure didn't deserve it, and I all I want is to spend some time with you.. that it! no expectation
message3.note: Kuch bhi chhota ho, milna hi kaafi hai.

options.label: Thik h..
options.sublabel: I will come so see you

yes-promise.body:
Thank you for saying haan. I promise it will not be loud or heavy — sirf ek din jo tumhare liye halka aur yaadgar ho.

Jo tumhe comfortable lage, wahi chalte hain.
yes-promise.note: Kuch bhi chhota ho, milna hi kaafi hai.

coffee.body:
Coffee theek hai. Koi aisi jagah jahaan tum ghabrao nahi — tumhari favourite wali ho sakti hai. Main bus saamne baithna chahta hoon, waise hi jaise pehle.

Saturday ko kab halka lagega?

movie.body:
Movie bhi acchi hai — thodi der ke liye duniya shant. Baad mein, agar mann kare, do minute ki chai. Koi plan force nahi karunga.

Saturday chalega?

walk.body:
Walk the most honest option lagti hai. Koi table nahi, koi script nahi. Bas thodi hawa, thodi der.

Koi park ya gali jahaan tum theek feel karo — wahi.

other-activity.body: Jo tumhe sahi lage, woh bata do. Main uske around sochunga — tumhari marzi pehle.
other-activity.note: Khali bhi chhod sakti ho, sirf milna kaafi hai.

other-ack.body: Suna. Jo bhi tumne socha, usko main halka rakhunga. Saturday ko milna ho, toh theek. Agar din badalna ho, woh bhi theek.

another-day.body:
Saturday sacred nahi hai. Jo din tumhare liye halka ho, wahi din sahi din hai.

Jab tum ready ho, bol dena. Main wait kar sakta hoon — quietly.

confirm-meet.body:
Theek hai. Main isko simple rakhunga — na zyada messages, na pressure.

Bas itna: tum aa rahi ho, aur main wahan hoonga. Itna sa milna, itne saalon ke baad, mere liye bahut hai.

Khayaal rakhna, Ruhi.
confirm-meet.note: Jab confirm karna ho, seedha keh dena. Main sun raha hoon.

unsure.body:
Sure nahi hona bilkul theek hai. Confusion bhi ek tarah ki imandari hai.

Main sirf yeh poochna chahta tha: kya dil mein thodi si jagah hai milne ki, ya abhi bhari hui hai?

no-ok.body:
It's okay. Main nahi maanoonga ki nahi ka matlab tumhe farq nahi padta.

Agar koi wajah hai jo hum saath mein halki kar sakein — bataogi? Nahi bhi batana chaho, toh bhi main yahin hoon.
no-ok.note: Jo bhi choose karo, uske baad bhi meri izzat rahegi.

options.label: Mujhe dar hai koi dekh lega toh, koi kya sochega
Bas mujhe nahi milna, mera man nahi hai

no-mood.body:
Man nahi hona bhi jawab hai. Kabhi thakaan hoti hai, kabhi mann shant rehta hai — usko argue nahi karna chahiye.

Main yeh nahi pooch raha ki tumhe force karke le aaoon. Sirf itna: kya yeh aaj ka feel hai, ya milna hi ab theek nahi lagta?

options.label: Aaj ka feel hai, kal dekhte hain
Chhoti si baat ho sakti hai, milna nahi

fear-seen.body:
Woh dar chhota nahi hai. “Koi dekh lega, koi kya sochega” — yeh dil ke andar baith jaata hai.

Main usko hasi mein nahi udaunga. Tumhari izzat meri pehli soch hai. Hum koi aisi jagah soch sakte hain jo quiet ho, familiar ho, jahaan tum perform na karo.

Koi announcement nahi. Sirf do log jo ek doosre ko lambi der se jaante hain.
fear-seen.note: Agar phir bhi nahi, toh nahi. Dar ko cross karna tumhari zimmedari nahi.

quiet-place.body:
Chalo. Koi corner café, ya koi aisi walk jahaan bheed kam ho. Main pehle se plan chhota rakhonga — late nahi, lamba nahi.

Tum bolo kab halka lage. Main us hisaab se aaunga.

options.label: Koi aur din, jab kam log hon

dont-want.body:
Suna. Aur main ruk jaunga.

Itna sa kehna tha: tum important ho, milna usse badi cheez nahi. Door rehna bhi, agar tumhe chahiye, ek tarah ka khayal hai.

Main sawaalon ki tarah nahi khada rahoonga.

small-step.body:
Chhoti si baat bhi milna hai, apne hisaab se. Call, message, jo tumhe safe lage.

Saturday ka milna chhodo — sirf itna: kya kabhi, jab mann kare, baat ho sakti hai?

end-later.body:
Theek hai. Main Saturday ko wait karke nahi baithunga. Jab tumhara man ho, woh din sahi din hoga.

Tab tak — khayal rakhna. Main yahin hoon, quietly.

end-space.body:
Space le lena. Dar ho ya thakaan, dono ko saans chahiye.

Main door se dua dunga ki tum halka feel karo. Jab ready ho, darwaza band nahi hoga.

end-respect.body:
Shukriya, jo tumne seedha kaha.

Itne saalon ki dosti ka matlab yahi hona chahiye — ki nahi ko bhi izzat mile. Tum theek raho, Ruhi. Baaki sab secondary hai.
